# external-snapshotter-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for the Kubernetes CSI external-snapshotter (VolumeSnapshot and VolumeGroupSnapshot APIs).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter](https://github.com/kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter)
at tag [`v8.6.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter/tree/v8.6.0) (commit `78e32cd84e0abec2621924a30e38c755f93e180a`),
path(s) `client/config/crd`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install external-snapshotter oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/external-snapshotter-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install external-snapshotter oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/external-snapshotter-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd volumegroupsnapshotclasses.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumegroupsnapshotcontents.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumegroupsnapshots.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshotclasses.snapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshotcontents.snapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshots.snapshot.storage.k8s.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd volumegroupsnapshotclasses.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumegroupsnapshotcontents.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumegroupsnapshots.groupsnapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshotclasses.snapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshotcontents.snapshot.storage.k8s.io volumesnapshots.snapshot.storage.k8s.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```
